parts.vi_name: Ke goc vuong 90 do vach thap & vuon
parts.mating_source: P03/P04/P05 front cutaway & P09..P13 garden corners (T=3.0 mm)
parts.notes: Ke goc nho gon cho vach cat mo mat truoc (34mm) va cum be nuoc - chau cay (48-54mm).

parts.vi_name: Kep chu U gia co moi noi tach manh
parts.mating_source: Split seams of P01A/P01B/P02/P05/P15 (T=3.0 mm + 0.20 mm clearance)
parts.notes: Kep chu U ranh 3.2mm truot khoa tren mep moi noi duoi en cua cac tam chia manh, chong cong venh.

parts.vi_name: Chan de nang nha (chong cham oc day)
parts.mating_source: Base perimeter 406x390 mm; clears P17_BASE_JOINER (Z=-6..-3 mm) + M3 nuts
parts.notes: Nang tam day nha cao 11mm khoi mat ban, chong cham thanh noi P17 va dau oc M3 duoi day.

parts.vi_name: Tru do Hub PCB M3x10 (in 3D)
parts.mating_source: P16_PCB_PLATE 90.0x70.0 mm M3 pattern (HW_PCB Z=9..19 mm)
parts.notes: Tru do M3 cao 10mm thay the tru dong gan Hub PCB 100x80mm len tam P16_PCB_PLATE (mau lo 90x70mm).

parts.vi_name: Tru do tam P16_PCB_PLATE M3x6 (in 3D)
parts.mating_source: P01A_BASE_TECH -> P16_PCB_PLATE 116.0x96.0 mm corner pattern (Z=0..6 mm)
parts.notes: Tru do M3 cao 6mm nang tam P16_PCB_PLATE phia tren tam day P01A_BASE_TECH (mau lo 116x96mm).

parts.vi_name: Khung de lien khoi Hub PCB 90x70
parts.mating_source: Exact P16_PCB_PLATE 90.0x70.0 mm M3 pattern for 100x80 mm Hub PCB
parts.notes: Khung do lien khoi tich hop 4 tru 10mm dung chuan lo 90x70mm (thay the tuy chon cho 4 tru roi SUP05).

parts.vi_name: Tru do module ngoai vi M3x8 (in 3D)
parts.mating_source: Relay1 (4x), Relay2 (4x), DHT11 (1x), KY-037 (1x), LM393 (1x) M3x8 standoffs
parts.notes: Tru do M3 cao 8mm thay tru nhua cho 2 module Relay (44.5x20.5mm), DHT11, KY-037 va LM393.

parts.vi_name: Khung de Relay 1 kenh 44.5x20.5
parts.mating_source: P01A_BASE_TECH Relay1 & Relay2 exact 44.5x20.5 mm M3 pattern
parts.notes: Khung de 4 tru lien khoi chuan 44.5x20.5mm cho Relay 1 va Relay 2 (thay the tuy chon cho 8 tru roi SUP08).

parts.vi_name: Gia kep mach khuếch dai PAM8403
parts.mating_source: P01A_BASE_TECH PAM_CLAMP_L/R (26.0 mm span, Dia 3.0 mm) + PAM8403 21x18 mm
parts.notes: Gia giu khay co dinh mach PAM8403 (21x18mm) khop dung 2 lo PAM_CLAMP cach nhau 26.0mm, khong can bang dinh xop.

parts.vi_name: Thanh ep giu loa tron 28mm
parts.mating_source: P15_TECH_FASCIA Speaker_Clamp_L/R (36.0 mm span, Dia 3.5 mm) + Dia 28x5.2 mm speaker
parts.notes: Thanh ep lung giu loa mini tron duong kinh 28mm ap sat luoi loa 19 lo tren P15_TECH_FASCIA.

parts.vi_name: Ban le cua chinh in 3D
parts.mating_source: P08_DOOR_LEAF Door_Hinge_Bot/Top (Dia 3.0 mm) to P05_WALL_FRONT jamb (2.0 mm clearance)
parts.notes: Cap ban le in 3D noi canh cua P08_DOOR_LEAF vao khung cua P05_WALL_FRONT, giu khe ho 2.0mm.
